comment: UniRig skeleton on exemplar_rigged.glb (52 bones, incl. full 5-finger chains per hand — UniRig detected fingers on this mesh). By position: spine bone_0..3, head bone_4/5, x+ arm bone_6(shoulder)/7(upperarm)/8(forearm)/9(hand)/10-24(fingers), x- arm bone_25/26/27/28/29-43, x+ leg bone_44(thigh)/45(calf)/46(foot)/47(toe), x- leg bone_48-51. Axes follow the berserkr-tuned UniRig conventions (axis 0 = flex).
